newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: DB Group sets dates for capital reduction.
newsitem.headline: DB Group sets dates for capital reduction.

text.p: Brewer DB Group Ltd on Friday said its three capital reduction proposals had been confirmed by the High Court and were now able to be implemented.
DB said April 24, at 5.00 p.m., had been fixed as the record date for the calculation of entitlements and May 15 had been fixed as the pay date.

In December, DB said cash balances were surplus to requirements and it would return them to shareholders by cancelling three out of every four fully-paid shares on issue, with a tax-free cash payment of 60 NZ cents for each cancelled share.
The capital reduction would involve the return of about NZ$181 million to shareholders.
DB is 59.8 percent owned by Asia Pacific Breweries Ltd, a venture between Heineken NV and Fraser and Neave Ltd.
